reason: The hypothesis synthesizes the observation of local SFE variations from P1/P25 with the concept of local chemical order roughening dislocation pathways from P7/P27, and applies this combined mechanism to explain strength differences across quinary, quaternary, and ternary subsets of the Cantor alloy—a specific comparative prediction that no single passage makes. The proposed falsification experiment, which systematically varies constituent count and measures local fluctuations, SFE, and deformation mechanisms, is a new integration not found in the literature.
